name: typing-indicator
title: Typing Indicator
description: A free React typing indicator for chat. Three liquid dots ride a wave inside a bubble, then fold away and the same bubble opens into the message, word by word. Names under the bubble say who is typing, avatars stack when several people are, and the wave quickens with the crowd.
